findings.title: Rendered hover coverage added
findings.body: New test fires mouseOver on a freshly remounted pending Start button and asserts screen.findByRole('tooltip') contains the expected 'Start task and switch active focus to: <title>' text, closing the previously accepted LOW risk that tests only checked source text.

findings.title: Rendered keyboard-focus coverage added
findings.body: Test also calls button.focus() plus fireEvent.focus after a Tab keydown (needed for jsdom :focus-visible matching, since MUI Tooltip only opens on focus-visible) and asserts the same tooltip text appears, giving both interaction modalities real DOM coverage.

findings.title: Weakened source-text regex retained as secondary check
findings.body: The pre-existing string-match assertion (line ~175) was kept but loosened to a regex tolerant of whitespace around the Tooltip JSX; this is now redundant with the rendered test but is not harmful — it still fails if the Tooltip is removed or its title format changes structurally.

findings.title: Accessible-name disambiguation relies on DOM structure, not aria semantics
findings.body: getPendingListStartButton() distinguishes the pending list Start button from the ritual 'Start Ritual' control via .closest('li') and aria-current!=='step' rather than a more robust selector (e.g., role='listitem' scoping or a dedicated test id). This works given current markup but is coupled to TaskSequencer's list structure and could silently break (find() returning undefined, caught by the explicit expect(pending).toBeTruthy()) if the DOM nesting changes materially in future refactors.

findings.title: Lint failure is a pre-existing environment gap, not introduced by F3
findings.body: ESLint fails on both candidate and main baseline due to missing eslint.config.* (ESLint 10 flat-config requirement), unrelated to this diff's content.
